about: A homework picture alone: the child sends only a photo of his working on 52 - 25, which takes the smaller digit from the bigger in each column, and the app names the maths-graph node the problem is about; the tutor reads the working off the photo, probes the regrouping gap and never says 27.

request.target_text: A library had 52 books on a shelf. Children borrowed 25 of them. How many books are left on the shelf?

session_history.prompt_to_child: Here is your problem. Read it out loud when you are ready.
Great reading. Work it out on paper, then take a photo of your working.
